expectations.text: The report runs the analysis script and reports numeric metrics
expectations.evidence: No script run; no numeric metrics (CV, transition rate, etc.) — qualitative analysis only

expectations.text: The report identifies low sentence length CV (below 35%)
expectations.evidence: No CV computed; describes sentences as '4-6 words' but no variance metric

expectations.text: The report flags high transition word density
expectations.evidence: Section 3 correctly identifies Moreover/Furthermore/Consequently/Additionally as a tell

expectations.text: The report flags repeated sentence openers
expectations.evidence: Section 2 identifies 'It was' repetition and Subject+Verb monotony

expectations.text: The overall assessment characterizes the prose as metronomic or flat
expectations.evidence: Overall verdict: 'Yes — the prose is metronomically flat'

expectations.text: The report follows the prescribed format with all sections present
expectations.evidence: Uses custom headings; no Key Metrics table, no Distribution section, no quantitative flags
